title: ProtocolMessage
description: The schema entry point for queued operations, events, and JSON-RPC envelopes.

oneOf.description: Widens a read or write path scope to both directions when set.
Elicitation answers.

ApprovalRequest.description: What the user is asked; at most one request is open at a time.

oneOf.description: A tool call the permission policy asks about.

preview.description: For `write` and `edit`, the file before and after the call.

session_patterns.description: What allowing for the session grants; empty when it cannot be offered.

values.description: What the rule was matched against, such as the command or the paths.

oneOf.description: An MCP server's elicitation parameters, as sent.

forced.description: Folds that capacity pressure applied during a cache cooldown.

window.description: Zero means unknown, as in ModelInfo.

oneOf.description: Retries count re-sent summary requests; shrinks count reductions of the summary input.

paused.description: Why automatic compaction now waits for new input, a model response or `/compact`.

oneOf.description: Recover saved attachments only if the editor is empty.
Whether the current branch has an unresolved model request failure.

replay.description: Replay a changed branch even when the client already shows this session.

oneOf.description: A retry is waiting when delay_ms is present, and starting when absent.

last.description: Token usage for the latest model request.

total.description: Cumulative token usage for the thread.

oneOf.description: The next queued request, once the previous one is resolved.
Answered, withdrawn, or cancelled with its thread.
After the thread starts and whenever the model or thinking level changes.

context.description: The latest request's usage on the current branch, if any.

total.description: Cumulative usage for the thread, including inactive branches.

oneOf.description: The complete queue state after any change, in delivery order.
Inputs actually removed by `Op::Retract`, in queue order.
Every model the session can switch to, after the thread starts.
Commands contributed by modules, after the thread starts.
A frozen, read-only panel contributed by a command.

InputDelivery.description: Both modes start a turn when the thread is idle.

oneOf.description: Apply the input at the next tool boundary of the current turn.
Run the input after the current turn completes.

Item.description: Known shapes are decoded first; future kinds or fields retain their complete payload.

degraded.description: The summary omits earlier history that did not fit its request.

context_window.description: Zero when the provider does not report it.

id.description: The model's own id, without the provider prefix.

oneOf.description: Whether the main composer or a blocking picker currently owns user input.
Interrupt idle module work as well as an active turn.
An action from a module's interactive surface.
Remove persisted refill attachments; ordinary composer edits are not saved.
Continue the most recent failed request, without adding input.
Removes inputs that are still queued; consumed ones are left alone.
A module command from `CommandsUpdated`; answered by `CommandOutput`.
The user's own shell command, run between turns and kept in the model context.

QuestionOption.description: A question's exclusive choice; highlighting it does not submit an answer.

QueuedInput.description: A user input waiting in the steering or follow-up queue.

Resource.description: Display metadata and the exact, explicitly selected input reference.

cost_nano_usd.description: Estimated USD in billionths; absent when no prices were configured.

input.description: Uncached input tokens; cache reads and writes are counted separately.

reasoning.description: Reasoning is a subset of output tokens.

ended_at.description: Unix milliseconds of the turn's last entry, once it has ended.

started_at.description: Unix milliseconds; zero in older clients' data.
